name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a services agreement governing a provider's AI services, including use of customer Input and generated Output, restrictions, and model training rights.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a customer.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, support, fees, data, warranties, liability, and term.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Agreement governing a provider's processing of customer personal data as processor or subprocessor, addressing GDPR and other data protection requirements.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement giving an early design partner access to a product in development in exchange for feedback and participation in the provider's program.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for a stated purpose while protecting it from further disclosure.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA capturing the purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law, jurisdiction, and any modifications to the standard terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement for business partnerships covering each party's obligations, feedback, trademark licensing, payments, confidentiality, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement letting a prospective customer evaluate a product or service before committing to a full commercial contract.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Agreement for professional services performed under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, cooperation, fees, IP ownership, and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms used with the Cloud Service Agreement defining target uptime, uptime calculation, support response times, and service credits.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing installable software, covering license grant, permitted uses, user accounts, fees, warranties, liability, and term.
